acceptanceCriteria.text: MineNotFound from getMineById probes or confirmed attackMine rejection removes the target, clears pending and continues safely without fatal error.
Interrupted and nearest candidates plus cached searches exclude missing targets; exhausted nearest scans retry with bounded backoff instead of requiring restart.
Previously persisted exact MineNotFound stop state recovers on the next tick; unrelated and unconfirmed mutation failures retain existing stop behavior.
Focused and background integration regressions, full tests, typecheck, build and docs validation pass.

Route explicit missing-target rejection through existing bounded skipMine; recover only the known persisted legacy MineNotFound error and add exhausted nearest scan backoff. 3. Add unit and actual background regressions covering continuation, fresh scans, legacy errors and unknown failures. 4. Verify checks, build patch release and update canonical contracts/task with D1-D5 compliance.

Actual background test proves another target is attacked with battleType:pve and confirmation waits for game response plus fresh rosters. Review: PASS, no unresolved P1/P2. Spec Decision Compliance: D1=pass, D2=pass, D3=pass, D4=pass, D5=pass.
